_comment: Phase 16D reference for the HOSTED cockpit read-models. The hosted Worker does NOT read this file (Cloudflare has no filesystem) — it builds the read-model registry in memory from Worker env (see src/runtime/cloudflare-live-read-models.ts). This file documents the EXACT env vars and the real, deployed read-only RPC allowlists. Use ONLY read-only anon keys — NEVER a service-role key. The browser never receives any key; the Worker calls Supabase RPCs server-side.

_safety.note: If a hosted read-model would require a service-role key, stop and report — do not ship. Read-only anon keys only. The Worker refuses service-role keys (isServiceRoleKey) by construction.
